answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the whisper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The cipher holds work receipts rather than names, so the thread of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
